newsitem.title: USA: Quaker State buys Axius for $40 mln-$50mln.
newsitem.headline: Quaker State buys Axius for $40 mln-$50mln.

text.p: A Quaker State Corp spokesman said Monday the company bought private Axius Holdings LP of Moorpark, Calif., for about $40 million to $50 million in cash.
The spokesman said the marketer of car window sun protection products had about $40 million to $50 million in annual sales and employs 117.
Anxius produces windshield sun protection products, organizers, window tint film, steering wheel covers, side window glare reducers, and winter protection products.
Quaker State is a motor oil and lubricants producer. Its stock traded at 15-3/4 Monday morning, down 1/8.
